name: @claudiu-ceia/dhash
description: Compute 64-bit dHash perceptual hashes and compare near-duplicate images.

scripts.check: bun run check:manifests && bun run check:css && bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run check:examples
scripts.check:css: bun run build:css && git diff --exit-code -- docs/styles.css
scripts.format: oxfmt mod.ts src tests examples scripts/check_manifests.ts scripts/package_metadata.ts
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check mod.ts src tests examples scripts/check_manifests.ts scripts/package_metadata.ts
scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings mod.ts src tests examples scripts/check_manifests.ts scripts/generate_fixtures.ts scripts/package_metadata.ts
scripts.check:examples: bun run examples/compare.ts tests/earthrise.jpg tests/earthrise-watermark.jpg && bun run examples/compare-bytes.ts tests/earthrise.jpg tests/earthrise-watermark.jpg
